source.caption_attribution: Adapted in the source book from L. Bocquet (2003), The physics of stone skipping.

change: The soft English-labeled raster was independently redrawn as a scalable accessible Indonesian SVG while preserving the coordinate axes, stone geometry, water surface, velocity, tangent and normal directions, dimensions, angles, and immersed-area notation.
method: Independent code-native SVG redraw; no source bitmap pixels were copied into the target.
accessibility: The SVG contains a Bahasa Indonesia title and a complete long description linked through aria-labelledby.
review: Rendered at 960 by 620 and visually inspected for legibility, arrow directions, labels, contrast, and unclipped geometry. The frozen source raster remains unchanged in the authority closure.
